profile: Owned synchronous callbacks in the expression grammar; production; top-level explicit root; no stores or hooks in Bend.
statusMeaning: Mapped functions remain restricted ports until all listed exclusions and branch obligations are closed. No source-line percentage is a proof-coverage percentage.

core/graph.ts:link.restrictions: No store nodes. Full stable-link/in-order generation mechanics are used by core.readPrepared.

core/graph.ts:unlinkSubs.restrictions: Unobserved callbacks, automatic dormancy cascades and store-release hooks remain open.

core/heap.ts:enqueueSub.restrictions: Pointer loops carry explicit resource bounds.

core/heap.ts:actualInsertIntoHeap.restrictions: Top-level roots only; nested root parentComputed height forwarding remains open.

core/heap.ts:insertIntoHeap.restrictions: Same flag tests, marking posture and intrusive bucket insertion on the admitted graph.

core/heap.ts:insertIntoHeapHeight.restrictions: Same flags and intrusive insertion; top-level root representation.

core/heap.ts:deleteFromHeap.restrictions: Explicit null IDs, no slot nodes.

core/heap.ts:markNode.restrictions: Depth-first explicit worklist preserves subscriber order; traversal budget is an explicit assumption until generalized progress proof.

core/heap.ts:markHeap.restrictions: Ordered intrusive bucket walks with resource bounds.

core/heap.ts:runHeap.restrictions: Continuation dispatch replaces callback recursion; zombie/tracked-effect routing remains open.

core/heap.ts:adjustHeight.restrictions: Same dependency traversal and height propagation for admitted nodes.

core/core.ts:signal.restrictions: Default strict equality or equals:false only; no snapshot or unobserved options.

core/core.ts:computed.restrictions: Owned sync callbacks only; no loading, extension, auto-dispose, custom-comparator or hook paths.

core/core.ts:setupComputedNode.restrictions: Root-owned nodes only; no nested root parent forwarding or snapshot/external hooks.

core/core.ts:recompute.restrictions: Sync successful pass, no owned child construction or cleanup, lanes/transactions/status/errors/snapshot hooks. Real stored expressions and actual read sets are evaluated.

core/core.ts:updateIfNecessary.restrictions: Sync status-free nodes; error retry and remaining retained flag postures open.

core/core.ts:prepareComputed.restrictions: Lazy initial activation and dead-node freeze only; observation-lifecycle reawakening open.

core/core.ts:pullComputed.restrictions: No fresh-read waiter config or verdict propagation; exact height-gated pull on the supported path.

core/core.ts:read.restrictions: Distinct source plain-signal fast block and slow tail, source unflushed flag, tracked linking and untrack-in-pass selection. No snapshot/verdict/held/status/strict-read paths; no nested root parent forwarding.

core/core.ts:serve.restrictions: Source order of unflushed probe, late-linker latch, committed selection and staged flag retained. Born-staged NotReady and staged errors refuse explicitly; held stash, spectating, verdict hooks and exception/status propagation unfinished.

core/core.ts:setSignal.restrictions: Pure synchronous updater expressions over staged composition; default strict equality/equals:false; no held/lane/snapshot/write hooks.

core/core.ts:untrack.restrictions: Tracking restoration on successful callback only. Thrown callbacks are explicitly unsupported; external-untrack hooks open.

core/scheduler.ts:queuePendingNode.restrictions: Source append then markUnflushedStaged outside the running window. Dev attribution not implemented.

core/scheduler.ts:bumpNotifyEpoch.restrictions: Unbounded mathematical Nat in proofs; emitted host natural-number range must be respected.

core/scheduler.ts:insertSubs.restrictions: Generation-current missed-wake condition and notify epoch retained. Snapshot and observe hooks open.

core/scheduler.ts:commitPendingNode.restrictions: Separate source signal/computed branches; configuration masks and inFlight branch, publication order, loading/manual-write reset, stale-tail trim and staged-effect enqueue retained. No cold extension; shownError, reask/flushed stash and parked-child disposal unfinished. Staged error notification is explicitly unsupported. Synthetic flight/status probes do not establish async execution.

core/scheduler.ts:commitPendingNodes.restrictions: Live pendingNodes bound, held/override guard, clear after walk, explicit exhaustion. Callback-driven list growth untested until cleanup/reentrant writes exist; no transaction/lane execution.

core/scheduler.ts:GlobalQueue.flush.bend: runtime/core.bend:round, heapLoop, seam, RenderQueue, UserQueue, RoundEnd
core/scheduler.ts:GlobalQueue.flush.restrictions: Source running -> resync -> heap -> settle -> clock/scheduled -> detached nonempty render/user queues for sync grammar. No dormancy, transactions, boundaries or effect callback writes.

core/scheduler.ts:GlobalQueue.settle.restrictions: Mainline live pending/held-trim walks, clearing after source walks. No error extensions, transaction/lane seams, store commit or boundary hooks.

core/scheduler.ts:flush.restrictions: Explicit host-driven flush only; microtask scheduling, flush(fn), actions, error halts open.

core/effect.ts:effect.restrictions: Separate compute/apply phases; schedule/defer/user options. No errors, returned cleanups, hold hooks.

core/effect.ts:runEffect.restrictions: Render callback mechanically writes stored result to text. User callback records application. Arbitrary imperative callbacks and cleanup/error/reentrant writes open.

core/owner.ts:linkChild.restrictions: Stable same-identity owner/computed nodes, head insertion and both sibling pointers.

core/owner.ts:disposeChildren.restrictions: Owned synchronous graph without cleanup/parked frames/reentrancy; future bookkeeping and dormant lifecycle open.

core/owner.ts:dispose.restrictions: Heap removal, clearDeps, owned descendant death and splice. No automatic dormancy.

core/core.ts:markRefresh.restrictions: Production invalidation branch now follows target flag update -> insertIntoHeap -> schedule, including REASK classification. Dev/observe hooks and async reask metadata are unfinished. The public refresh waiter API is not implemented.

core/core.ts:stagedRead.bend: runtime/core.bend:stagedRead; serve invokes it on staged selection
core/core.ts:stagedRead.restrictions: Source REACTIVE_STAGED_READ flag and uninitialized guard are retained in the synchronous profile. Lane stagedReaders collection and callers in other unported paths remain unfinished.

core/core.ts:markUnflushedStaged.restrictions: Module boolean is a World field, set by the actual pending intake.

core/core.ts:readerSeesCommitted.restrictions: Source no-reader/no-staging/children-forbidden predicate. Does not implement tracked-effect API.

core/core.ts:unflushedValue.restrictions: Source running/no-staging/promoted guards and committed Slot. Held cold-extension stash refuses explicitly pending extension translation.

core/core.ts:markLateLinker.restrictions: Source MISSED_WAKE latch; source true return is implicit in the serve branch.

core/core.ts:notePromotedWrite.restrictions: Source running/already-promoted guards, config bit and once-only append. Direct helper probes only; in-callback writes and promotion publication remain unfinished.

core/core.ts:resyncUnflushedCompanions.restrictions: Source flag reset, length guard, promotion-bit walk and clear. Called at the actual flush entry; no alternate scheduler.

policy: Operation-level source fidelity is required. Formal TS/Bend equivalence is not required. Restricted and partial entries are location mappings, not completed line-by-line alignment. See tracking/source-fidelity.md.
